negative_control: exact unchanged parent replay must remain 109 rolling closed trades with saved trade/unresolved/PnL parity
single_axis: episode_traded changes from turn-event time to actual modeled entry acceptance time; rejected regime, cost, fill-clock, or occupied candidates do not consume the episode
hypothesis: pre-acceptance episode consumption suppresses causal later same-episode entries; recovered entries must add positive after-cost marginal net without erasing parent large winners
falsifier: reject if added-trade marginal Net is nonpositive at cost1x or cost2x, or if total economics/risk/winner retention fails current SSOT
unchanged: 30m UTC complete-bar clock and next-open entry
six-symbol cohort and 245-calendar-day used DEV window
GMMA Holy Grail turn setup and PANIC_DISPERSION/TREND_DISPERSED regimes
ATR/cost admission, frozen symbol costs, stop-first/gap/unresolved handling
stop, scratch, fee-BE, partial, runner, max-hold and per-symbol occupancy
independent flat execution ownership at each preregistered window
evaluation: cost1x and cost2x T, T/day, Gross, Cost, Net/day, Net/T, PF, WR, payoff
realized simultaneous-close-cohort DD, max loss streak, tail and hold
profit/loss/zero-realized/no-entry days, worst day and consecutive loss days
common, added and removed opportunities; added marginal Net and parent winner retention
forbidden: stop widening, leverage, averaging, split-order frequency inflation

source_evidence.freqtrade_callback_principle: signal, confirm_trade_entry and order_filled are separate lifecycle stages; used as design evidence only, not donor economics
